column1: # Nine Commits, post 4 — every trace committed in this repository, graded twice.
# The rows below are generated, not typed. This header is not:
#   npm run eval -- --tsv
# answer_grade is the recorder's rule recomputed from the committed file: a
# case-insensitive substring check of the final answer against the facts the
# run was told to expect. It is the column posts 2 and 3 published as the
# outcome, and it agrees with the recorded_outcome column on every row it
# grades. Row 1 is the exception and is not a disagreement: post 1's
# question has no fact a substring could check, so there is nothing to
# recompute and the column reads `ungraded` against a recorded `failure`.
# The rest read the frames instead of the sentence.
# tools_called    the tools the run asked for, in order.
# observations    how many things a tool actually put in front of the model: a
#                 file name from list_files, or a line of file contents from
#                 search_files. The two are counted the same here and are NOT
#                 the same thing anywhere else in this file.
# unread_claims   facts the final answer states that appear in no line any
#                 tool returned. The agent either inferred them from a file
#                 name or supplied them itself.
# provenance      grounded    the ground-truth line was observed, no copy was
#                 undecidable both were observed; the trace cannot say which
#                             one the answer came from
#                 from-copy   a copy was observed, the ground truth was not
#                 unevidenced neither was observed
#                 ungradable  the question has no single line for an answer
# ground_truth_sightings / copy_sightings  the counts behind that verdict. A
#                 copy is any line OUTSIDE the source file carrying the value
#                 the answer turns on. The rule over-counts on purpose.
# Rows 4, 5 and 6 carry the same final answer, character for character, and
# three different evidence sets behind it.
